 Brown Act
Agendas are drafted to accurately state what the legislative body is being asked to consider.
The legislative body can take action on "all items" listed on the agenda and be in compliance
with the open meeting laws. Under the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless
it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The
governing body may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration
at a future meeting.

Meeting Compensation Disclosure
Pursuant to Government Code Section 54952.3: Disclosure of compensation for meeting
attendance by Citizen Advisory Committee is $25.00 per meeting.

  1. Fiscal Year 2026-2027 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Funding
  Presentations by the following applicants:

  PUBLIC SERVICE:
  Laura Maldonado, Family Violence Prevention Program - City of South Gate Police Department
  Osie Harrell, Graffiti Abatement Program - City of South Gate Public Works Department
  Jose Gonzalez, Field Training Officer - South Gate Police Explorers
  Ana Ramirez, South Gate Home Modification Program - Southern California Rehabilitation Services

  NON-PUBLIC SERVICE:
  Director, South Gate Chamber of Commerce - South Gate Women's Business Center

  NOTE: The California Latino Leadership Institute withdrew its $33,000 application for the South Gate
  Chamber Internship Program
  PUBLIC COMMENT: Mario Dominguez, South Gate Resident

Minutes  Page 1 of 2  7
Citizen Advisory Committee.02.25.26
   MOTION: Motion by Committee Member Castillo and seconded by Chairperson Gonzalez to approve the
  proposed Fiscal Year 2026-2027 CDBG funding recommendations as follows:
  Family Violence Prevention Program - $27,000

  Graffiti Abatement Program - $100,000

  South Gate Police Explorers - $23,000

  South Gate Home Modification Program - $15,000

  South Gate Women's Business Center - $12,000 (non-public service funding)

  The Committee further recommended that if additional public-service CDBG funding is received, the
  additional amount be allocated to the Graffiti Abatement Program. If less public-service funding is received,
  the reduction will be taken from the Graffiti Abatement Program. Motion carried unanimously, with the
  following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Chairperson Gonzalez, Vice Chair Zepeda, Committee Members Castillo, Zavala,
  Martinez, Janer
  NOES:  None
  ABSTAIN: None
  ABSENT: Committee Members Delgado, Mendoza, Richard Gonzales
